_doc: Canonical arch-id / SKU alias map. The bare sm_120 deployment token selects the active RTX 5090 card. Build-only tokens remain compile-time vocabulary and are not deploy identities.
_rejected_doc: Uncaptured device tiers remain rejected. The GeForce RTX 5090 has a dedicated card and must be named explicitly; a bare sm_120 token is not enough to select a SKU.
